_comment: Exceptions to the uncertainty rule's 50% (MAX_UNCERTAINTY in pca.js), one dividing line each. A line is found by its anchor statements, like the names in line-labels.json: build.js applies an entry to the line where at least 2 anchors are among its 10 strongest statements (either end), and warns if none matches. Each exception is temporary: remove it once the line has statements that ordinary politicians take positions on (backlog/new-statements.md).

lines.why: The line's core statements (unity across borders: civilizational and kin-people unions, pooled sovereignty, a shared currency) are ones mainstream politicians rarely address; four models found no line-13 positions in Zohran Mamdani's record. Brandon: 60% until the line has mainstream statements.
